soundtrack.music: Serious, premium AI product launch film score, like the reveal videos of leading AI companies: a deep pulsing synth bass, precise minimal electronic percussion, evolving arpeggiated synths and cinematic tension that builds as the AI thinks, then a confident driving groove when it answers. Sophisticated, focused and powerful, never cute or playful. Around 112 BPM, clear space for a voice-over. Ends on a deep cinematic hit. No vocals.
